items.title: Why Are Brown & Brown (BRO) Shares Soaring Today
items.summary: Shares of insurance brokerage firm Brown & Brown (NYSE:BRO) jumped 5% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter results that saw investors look past a slight revenue shortfall and focus on strong year-over-year growth and in-line earnings. The insurance brokerage firm's revenue grew by a robust 30.4% year-over-year to $1.68 billion, although this figure came in just below analyst estimates of $1.72 billion.
